description: All-in-one database client and SQL studio for Orca. Browse multi-schema objects, edit data inline, paste spreadsheets, import CSV/JSON, design schemas, run multi-tab SQL with bind params and manual transactions over SSH/TLS across 9 built-in engines (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, CockroachDB, ClickHouse, Redis, Turso/LibSQL, Cloudflare D1) plus SHA-256-verified local BYOD drivers.
